meta.regionalProfileSource: Vic_Reg Data Final for Iteration 1.xlsx - LGA_Master_Data.csv

regionalProfileQuality.joinNote: All 56 CSV LGAs match the existing application profiles by LGA name and verified LGA code. The blank separator column in the exported CSV is ignored.
regionalProfileQuality.sourceStatement: The supplied Iteration 1 CSV is authoritative for 2025 population, VIF 2021/2026 population, SEIFA, 2025 median house price, September 2025 rent and July 2026 highest-demand occupation. Fields not supplied by this CSV retain their previously integrated reviewed values.

meta.geographicWarning: Population, house price and rent are LGA-level. Employment demand is mapped from the dominant SA4-level geography and may cover a wider area.
meta.periodWarning: Population, rent, house price, employment, safety and projection fields use different reference periods. Read referencePeriods before comparison.
meta.priceToIncomeWarning: Price-to-income compares 2025 median house price with annualised 2021 Census median weekly household income.
meta.externalApiMigration: The frontend consumes the stable /api region contract. Replace the backend CSV provider with an external provider without changing page components.

referencePeriods.priceToIncomeRatio: 2025 house price / annualised 2021 Census household income
